info.title: ModelAnvil Control Plane REST API

BearerAuth.description: Tenant API key prefixed with mkv_

BrowserSession.name: modelanvil_session
BrowserSession.description: HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax, 24-hour browser credential. Unsafe requests additionally require X-CSRFToken.

CSRFToken.name: X-CSRFToken
CSRFToken.description: Required with browser cookies on unsafe methods, including sign-up and sign-in.

secret.description: Plaintext secret token, returned only at creation

source_format.description: training automatically reads role-preserving messages, prompt/response pairs or text from JSONL, JSON or CSV. It allocates whole source groups proportionally.

chunk_characters.description: Optional deterministic character-bound chunking of single plain text blocks. Source-level privacy/protected checks run before chunking; tokenizer bounds remain preflight checks.

id.description: Tenant-scoped relation record ID for training inputs; resource URLs use model_version_id.

chat_template.description: Imported template or the exported role template of a completed chat SFT candidate.

total_steps.description: Runtime-specific limits are checked during preflight.

progress_step.description: Observed optimizer progress; current_step remains the durable checkpoint cursor.

quality_summary.description: Validation loss does not establish answer accuracy.

export_options.description: Supported download formats for this completed run; empty before completion. No format conversion is implied.

method.description: Defaults to GET. Synthetic candidate registration requires POST.

draft_configuration.description: Prompt and rubric pinned when the batch opens.

qualification.description: Recorded independent evaluation decision, threshold/baseline comparison and preserved prior model.

dataset_manifest_digest.description: Server-derived from actual pinned artifact bytes; required only for legacy digest-only saved plans.

held_out_validation_digest.description: Server-derived from actual pinned artifact bytes; required only for legacy digest-only saved plans.

train_dataset_artifact.description: Committed, accessible filesystem preference artifact, checked by digest and size. Training and held-out prompts must be disjoint.

held_out_dataset_artifact.description: Committed, accessible filesystem preference artifact, checked by digest and size. Training and held-out prompts must be disjoint.

AlignmentRunInput.description: Pending alignment plan. Actual execution requires both committed preference artifact UUIDs. Digest-only legacy plans are readable but cannot execute. DPO and PPO require a reference; PPO additionally requires an actual serialized reward head.

RunDetail.description: Read-only projection of one logical run: observed state, desired state, ownership, pinned inputs, metrics, checkpoints, budget usage, linked records and the evidence-based recovery blockers.

observed.description: State actually recorded for this run.

desired.description: Requested state and whether the worker acknowledged it.

ownership.description: held, released, lost or unknown worker ownership.

actions.description: Cancellation availability and the recorded reasons that block a resume or retry.

max_tokens.description: Estimated content token cap before serialization; role wrappers are included in the final prompt allocation.

output_reserve_tokens.description: Must be less than the model limit.

blocks.description: Unique block keys; up to 500,000 total content characters.

model_version.description: Accessible committed CPU character/general-transformer model record. Server freezes weight/tokenizer/runtime/template pins; unsupported/corrupt bundles refuse. Omit for estimator-only compilation.

ContextVersionInput.description: Pinned CPU recipes enforce the actual model context (at most 64 tokens) and 1–32 output tokens; other recipes use labeled estimated counts. Source blocks remain immutable.

source_uri.description: Stable local source identifier; never fetched from the network.

documents.description: At most 2 MB UTF-8 text and 10,000 chunks per import.

chunk_overlap.description: At most half the chunk size.

AlignmentHyperparameters.description: Finite numeric values only; booleans are rejected. beta is DPO-only. KL/clip/rollout/value knobs are PPO/verifier-only. Unknown or recipe-incompatible knobs are rejected. budget_policy_id selects an enabled tenant training_steps policy.

AlignmentVerifierSpec.description: Required for verifier_rl. Targets come from chosen responses; sampled completions receive actual rule rewards. Tolerance must be finite and within 0–1000000.

PreferencePair.description: Nonblank text, distinct responses, unique triples. Prompt plus each response must be at most 62 characters. Execution requires complete policy vocabulary coverage.

train_dataset_artifact.description: Committed, accessible filesystem preference artifact, checked by digest and size. Training and held-out prompts must be disjoint.

held_out_dataset_artifact.description: Committed, accessible filesystem preference artifact, checked by digest and size. Training and held-out prompts must be disjoint.

files.description: Local verified artifact references keyed by supported filenames.

download_scope.description: full includes every original file and split in the content-pinned full-release manifest. Samples keep the existing bounded training preparation.

record_limit.description: Sample bound; full downloads require the exact full-release source-file count.

max_storage_quota_bytes.description: Full downloads require twice the release byte size for final objects and retained resumable parts.

estimated_amount.description: Positive bank_acquisition_records reservation; full releases count verified source files.

planned_records.description: Source files for full releases, samples for sample acquisition.

transferred_bytes.description: Verified complete files plus verified resumable parts of the current file.

source_files.description: Ready full releases only. Download each artifact through the tenant/project-authorized streaming artifact endpoint.

revision_id.description: Full raw releases do not publish a canonical training revision.

worker_token.description: Shown once in an administrator no-store response; never in inventory.

SpecialistDecisionInput.description: At most 32,000 JSON bytes; token preflight refuses state, instruction or option truncation. English root checkpoint; domain calibration pending.

layout_model.description: Optional pinned PP-DocLayoutV3 model for ordered region recognition.

SpecialistOcrInput.description: Per-page output limit; PDF sources allow 1–5 pages and 6 million total rendered pixels. Empty, encrypted or partial documents are refused.

review_freshness.description: Current evidence, access, frozen consumer and model-byte checks for local reviews. Invalid reviews redact case content and disable reviewed exports and local serving. Quality criteria remain independent.

release_version_id.description: Exact public identity of the deployed release version.

request.description: SpecialistOcrInput or SpecialistDecisionInput; layout-only runs use CPU placement.

budget_policy.description: Enabled currency-free specialist_attempts policy. Three attempts reserved.

items.description: Typed step fields and dependencies are validated by the recipe compiler. Only earlier-step dependencies are permitted; all steps must contribute to the final output.

RecipeRunInput.description: Full runs require reviewed_preview and a completed preview with exactly matching recipe/source/model/runtime/protected bindings. Generation uses a registered pinned local worker.

password.description: Sign-up requires at least 10 characters and Django password validation.

token.description: Client mode marker, not a credential. The credential is set only in the HttpOnly cookie.

TrainingSourceMapping.description: Maps source columns to training roles. The normalized mapping is recorded in the immutable preparation recipe; full source bytes remain unchanged.

can_prepare.description: False when any record requires repair. Warnings do not block preparation. Model token limits are checked separately in the tokenizer preview.

rows.description: One-based source record indices, excluding CSV headers. Full-file counts; at most five row references per issue.

LabelingCycleConfiguration.description: Opt-in real CPU character training and protected evaluation; quantity budgets and campaign caps required. Currency costs are unmeasured; budget_limit_dollars must be0. Suite digest is pinned by the server.

source_pins.description: Frozen owner/build scope, current-permission requirement, source revisions and chunk recipe. Source revision preview is capped at 50 with explicit count/truncation.

metadata.description: Authoritative source title/URI/revision/hash and exact character spans override untrusted chunk metadata.

qrels.description: Current authorized chunk UUIDs to relevance grades; no positive grades yields N/A.

RetrievalComparisonInput.description: Bounded synchronous retrieval comparison on frozen indexes. Optional baseline must share the knowledge base and all judged chunks. Dense/hybrid require actual caller vectors and a compatible index; semantic model qualification is not inferred.

RetrievalComparisonReport.description: Invalidated/legacy reports withhold metrics and query content. Positive-qrels coverage is explicit; N/A cases are excluded from aggregate means.

settings.description: Measured method/version/input digest, actual rank/dimension/variance, bounds and limitations. PCA basis and means are not exported.

MeasuredProjection.description: Real centered SVD PCA and bounded k-means on provided vectors. Unsupported UMAP and legacy hash coordinates refuse; changed/revoked/tombstoned inputs invalidate the projection.

ContextPairInput.description: At most 16000 variable characters/case. Distinct case IDs; identical frozen cases/decoding for both variants. Memory fixtures include only matching-session nonexpired entries and cannot accompany raw memory. No live tools, GPU or paid provider.

details.description: Actual CPU origin; frozen cases and digest, recipe digests, weight/tokenizer/template/runtime pins, decoding/seeds/environment and each variant prompt/output/usage/latency/retention/omissions/failure. Reports with changed or inaccessible inputs withhold results.

ContextExperimentEvidence.description: Exact-match fraction includes failures in the denominator and declares completion coverage. This bounded reference experiment does not establish general model quality or injection safety.

ModelImportPlan.description: Server-reinspected immutable source metadata and current bounded runtime eligibility. Import verifies source/container bytes and supported text tensor shapes; no production or successful model-load qualification is inferred.

TrainingDeviceMemoryObservation.description: Fresh framework free-memory or explicit process-allowance observation. Not an immutable placement pin, reservation or guarantee against unrelated applications.
